sources.snippet: A quantization stack: model.quantize()and libreyolo quantizewith nine recipes, honest simulation-based accuracy, QAT / QAD recovery, and packed low-bit checkpoints. Two new trackers: BoT-SORT and Deep OC-SORT (appearance ReID), alongside ByteTrack and OC-SORT.
